Give me a quick Motoi snippet.

```motoi
(define (draw-grid-rectangle cols rows)
  (let* ((cell-size 14)
         (start-x (- 128 (quotient (* cols cell-size) 2)))
         (start-y (- 96 (quotient (* rows cell-size) 2))))
    (plot/with
      (list (cons 'title (string-append
                           "Area = " (number->string cols) " × "
                           (number->string rows) " = "
                           (number->string (* cols rows))
                           " square units")))
      (apply append
        (map (lambda (r)
               (map (lambda (c)
                      (let ((x (+ start-x (* c cell-size)))
                            (y (+ start-y (* r cell-size))))
                        (plot/line
                          (list (list x y) (list (+ x cell-size) y)
                                (list (+ x cell-size) (+ y cell-size))
                                (list x (+ y cell-size)) (list x y))
                          (list (cons 'color "black") (cons 'width 1)))))
                    (range 0 cols)))
             (range 0 rows))))))

(draw-grid-rectangle 6 5)
```

Give me an expert example of `entity/glide!`.

```motoi
(define (choreograph-sequence entity points ease-name)
  (define (next-waypoint pts)
    (if (null? pts)
      'sequence-done
      (let ((pt (car pts)))
        (entity/glide! entity (car pt) (cadr pt) 20 ease-name)
        pts)))
  (next-waypoint points))
(let ((dancer (world/spawn 'dancer 100 100)))
  (choreograph-sequence dancer '((150 100) (150 200) (100 200)) 'in-out))
```
